desc:
Punch a GIANT mountain until it falls! 👊⛰️

Play solo or team up with up to 4 friends.

HOW TO PLAY
👊 Punch blocks and collect the drops
💰 Sell them for cash
⬆️ Upgrade power, speed, punch area and backpack
💎 Destroy the Core and earn gems

FEATURES
🏔️ 3 difficulties: Easy, Medium and Hard
⚔️ 12 classes, each with its own power and gear
🥊 Collectible gloves, including Spin Wheel exclusives
🎡 Free Spin every 24 hours
🕊️ Skill tree that unlocks flight and higher jumps
🏆 Fastest-win leaderboards, with separate No Robux runs
🎮 PC, mobile and controller support

How fast can you bring it down? Press Play and start punching!
